// diagnostic E1137

Jet.OpenNotPublicEnum

`#Open` is on {kind} `{name}`, not a public enum.

What

`#Open` is on {kind} `{name}`, not a public enum.

Why

`#Open` marks a public enum whose variants may grow across releases without breaking external matches.

Fix

Remove `#Open` from `{name}`, or use it on a public `enum`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.OpenNotPublicEnum: Tests/UI/open_not_public_enum.stderr.
